test_approval_hooks_cli_path: test the pre_approval_request and post_approval_response hooks fire on the CLI interactive approval path
test_approval_hooks_gateway_path: test the pre_approval_request and post_approval_response hooks fire on the async gateway approval path
test_plugin_crash_safety: test that a crashing plugin hook does not break the approval flow for the user
test_gateway_timeout: test that the post_approval_response hook reports timeout choice when gateway approval expires
test_approval_deny_hook: test that the post_approval_response hook correctly reports when a dangerous command is denied
